scope: Native resident-reference policy calibration check. Full timers include model construction, material scaling/packing, forward, point proxy objective, replay and backward. Input allocation, oracle, checks and final host copies excluded. Tuning wall time includes planning and comparison. Torch peaks exclude context and non-Torch allocations. No beyond-VRAM, physical optical-convergence, complete optimizer or external-solver claim.

tuning.scope: Selection from measured prefixes with optional two-duration checkpoint-replay extrapolation. Generated candidates fit current budgets and may fall back to explicitly configured file banks. File timings include OS cache effects. Full-duration optimality, resident-vs-streamed selection and sustained physical-storage performance are not established.
